column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 24.12.2019

(i) 
In  the  case  of  projects  carried  out  under  direct  labor  by  the  Pradeshiya  Sabha,  work  shall  be
carried  out  in  accordance  with  the  approved  estimate  and  any  modification  thereof  shall  be
approved by the council or the authority authorized by the council.

(ii) 
The estimate that should be prepared regarding the work done by direct labour in a Pradeshiya
Sabha should be approved by the Council.
